COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
CLCON No.310 of 2022
Shri S.K.Mishra, J.
Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel
for the contempt-applicant.
By filing the Civil Contempt, the
petitioner has prayed to initiate a
contempt proceeding against the
respondent/contemnor for committing the
willful contempt of the Court by non-complying and flouting the order dated
29.10.2021 passed by this Hon'ble Court
in WPMS No. 1929 of 2021 Maladevi @
Malavati vs. District Magistrate,
Haridwar. However, this Court is of the
opinion that there is no contempt of the
order passed by this Court as there is no
willful and deliberate disobedience of the
order in view of the fact that the matter
was remanded to the District Magistrate,
Haridwar to consider the application of
the petitioner. However, the petitioner is
aggrieved by the order passed by the
learned District Magistrate, Haridwar,
who reconsidered and rejected the
application of the petitioner.
Now, the petitioner is aggrieved of
such order. That would not amount the
contempt and accordingly, the contempt
petition is dropped.

(S.K.Mishra, J.)
 20.10.2022
 (Grant urgent copy of this order as per Rules)
